paraphrase: Vijñānabhikṣu criticises the doctrine of the 'modern' (ādhunika) self-styled Vedāntins — that difference is unreal and the world māyā — as not the purport of the Brahmasūtras, and, quoting the Padma Purāṇa's verses on māyāvāda as 'Buddhism in disguise', counts it among heterodox teachings; he himself teaches non-separation (avibhāga) of the selves from the Lord with real distinction.
speaker: Vijñānabhikṣu
notes: From memory; the Sāṃkhyapravacanabhāṣya is not in the local corpus. Whether the Padma verses are quoted in the introduction or in the comment on an early sūtra (e.g. 1.22) is unverified.
